agenda_text:
CC/SA/IDA/PAA/PCA/PFA MEETING - FEBRUARY 5, 2019 - 7:00 P.M.
CC/SA/IDA/PAA/PCA/PFA MEETING - FEBRUARY 5, 2019 - 7:00 P.M.
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 05, 2019
07:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 1446
www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
SPEAKER FORMS: &nbspFor record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
3. ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM BISHOP, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND LOA
4. PRESENTATION:
4.1 Palmdale Animal Care Center representative will present a cute critter that is available for adoption from our local Animal Care Center.
4.2 Presentation by Mayor and Council of Certificates of Recognition to the following people for their support of the SAVES' 2018 Thanksgiving Holiday Program.
* David G. Millen Student Leadership
4.3 Presentation by Mayor and Council of Certificates of Recognition to the following people for their support of the SAVES' 2018 Christmas Holiday Program.
* La Juana Hamada
* Antelope Valley Transit Authority "Stuff-A-Bus"
* Antelope Valley Mall
* California Highway Patrol
* Toys for Tots
* Palmdale Aerospace Academy Robotics
* David G. Millen Student Leadership
4.4 Presentation by Mayor and Council of Certificates of Recognition to the following youth for their outstanding oratorical and leadership skills and community involvement in the Heights of Greatness Leadership Institute (HGLI) – Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.'s (MLK) 5th Annual Leadership Gala.
* Ashley Martinez
* Angelie Zambrano
* Kayla Anderson
* Madison Anderson
* Lyriq Wooten
* Jaliah C. Smith
* Nick Eshrati
5. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S) and ORDINANCE(S):
Staff Recommendation: Waive full reading of the Resolution(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting.
6. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEM NOS. 7.1 through 7.14 (CONSENT CALENDAR).
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve items listed under this Consent Calendar by one vote.
7. CONSENT CALENDAR:
Staff Recommendation: Approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under this Consent Calendar by one vote.
7.1 CC - Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the City of Palmdale’s books as of December 31, 2018. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the City of Palmdale’s books.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.1
7.2 CC - Accept the quarterly report on the investment balances as reported on the City of Palmdale’s books as of December 31, 2018. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Accept the quarterly report on the investment balances as reported on the City of Palmdale’s books.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.2
7.3 CC - Award of Invitation for Bids (IFB) No. 18-001-3220 Streetlight Poles (Purchase) and approval of Purchase Order No. 20190509 with All-State Utility Supply, Inc. to provide Streetlight Poles and Related Items. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Award of Invitation for Bids (IFB) No. 18-001-3220 Streetlight Poles (Purchase) and approval of Purchase Order No. 20190509 with All-State Utility Supply, Inc.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.3
7.4 CC - ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-019, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE DESIGNATING BY TITLE AND NAME THOSE OFFICIALS WHO ARE AUTHORIZED TO SIGN CHECKS AND WARRANTS, AND REPEALING RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-086, EFFECTIVE FEBRUARY 5, 2019. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-019.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.4
7.5 CC - Approval of the City’s 2019 Federal Agenda to promote Palmdale’s priorities and legislative initiatives at the federal level. (Staff Reference: City Manager Purtee)
Staff Recommendation: Approval of the City’s 2019 Federal Agenda to promote Palmdale’s priorities and legislative initiatives.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.5
7.6 CC - Acceptance of Completed Capital Project, Project No. 771, Yellen Park Shade Structures, with R.E. Schultz Construction, Inc., budgeted in capital improvement account P0051, Agreement No. A-6230. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Acceptance of Completed Capital Project, Project No. 771, Yellen Park Shade Structures, with R.E. Schultz Construction, Inc.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.6
7.7 CC - Award of Project No. 767, Pelona Vista Park Fitness Court Installation Project, to Pacific Tennis Courts, Inc., in the amount of $98,500, budgeted in multiple accounts, Agreement No. A-6513. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Award of Project No. 767, Pelona Vista Park Fitness Court Installation Project, to Pacific Tennis Courts, Inc.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.7
7.8 CC - Approval of Amendment No. 3 to Agreement with Paragon Partners, Ltd. to provide consultant services for the acquisition of right of way to widen State Route 138 (Palmdale Boulevard), between 5th and 10th Street East and widen Sierra Highway between Avenue Q and Avenue R, budgeted in Account No. S0049208-72525-3025, Agreement No. A-5121. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Approval of Amendment No. 3 to Agreement with Paragon Partners, Ltd.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.8
7.9 CC - ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-003, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE ORDERING THE VACATION OF A PORTION OF AVENUE R-5 AND THE RESERVATION OF UTILITY EASEMENTS THEREIN. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-003.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.9
7.10 CC - Acceptance of Completed Capital Project, Project No. 729, Council Chambers Audio Visual Upgrade Project, with Integrated Media Systems and authorize the Director of Public Works to file a Notice of Completion for construction only, in the amount of $781,791.04, budgeted in Account No. F0046101-724525, Agreement No. A-5955. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Acceptance of Completed Capital Project, Project No. 729, Council Chambers Audio Visual Upgrade Project, with Integrated Media Systems.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.10
7.11 SA - Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Palmdale’s books as of December 31, 2018. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the Successor Agency.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.11
7.12 SA - Accept the quarterly report on the investment balances as reported on the Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Palmdale’s books as of December 31, 2018. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Accept the quarterly report on the investment balances as reported on the Successor Agency.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.12
7.13 SA - ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. SA 2019-003, A RESOLUTION OF THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE DESIGNATING BY TITLE AND NAME THOSE OFFICIALS WHO ARE AUTHORIZED TO SIGN CHECKS AND WARRANTS AND REPEALING RESOLUTION NO. SA 2018-010, EFFECTIVE FEBRUARY 5, 2019. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. SA 2019-003.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.13
7.14 Approve the minutes from the previous meetings. (Staff Reference: City Clerk/Agency Secretary Smith)
* CC - October 16, 2018 (7pm), November 27, 2018 (7pm), December 18, 2018 (7pm), January 8, 2019 (5pm)
* CC/SA - January 8, 2019 (7pm)
* CC/SA/PCA/PFA - December 11, 2018 (7pm)
* IDA – June 5, 2018 (7pm)
* PAA – June 5, 2018 (7pm)
Staff Recommendation: Approve the minutes from the previous meetings.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.14
8. PUBLIC HEARING:
8.1 Public Hearing to: 1) hear public comment and review a proposal to amend the City's 2018-2019 Action Plan to reprogram Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) funds of $372,970 from 2017-2018 Unprogrammed and $7,160 from 2017-2018 ADA Compliance - Facility Improvements to 2018-2019 ADA Compliance - Facility Improvements; and 2) to authorize the City Manager or his designee to sign all documents necessary to amend said Action Plans and obtain HUD approval. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
Staff Recommendation: Approve the recommendations and findings as listed in the staff report.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 8.1
9. NEW BUSINESS:
9.1 City Council prioritization of the completion of unfinished park amenities and adoption of Resolution No. CC 2019-015 authorizing an interfund loan of $5 million from General Fund Reserves to the Park Development Fund and authorizing the City Manager to execute any and all the necessary interfund loan documents, agreements, and repayment schedules. (Staff Reference: City Manager Purtee)
9.1a RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-015, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AUTHORIZING AN INTERFUND LOAN OF $5 MILLION FROM GENERAL FUND OPERATING RESERVES TO THE PARK DEVELOPMENT FUND.
Staff Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. CC 2019-015.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 9.1
10. JOINT NEW BUSINESS OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE CITY COUNCIL, SUCCESSOR AGENCY, HOUSING AUTHORITY, INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, PALMDALE AIRPORT AUTHORITY, PALMDALE CIVIC AUTHORITY, AND PALMDALE FINANCING AUTHORITY:
10.1 Budget recommendation and priorities from City Council to be used in developing the fiscal year 2019//20 budget. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 10.1
11. NON-AGENDA ITEMS – PUBLIC COMMENTS:
12. INFORMATIONAL REPORT FROM MAYOR AND / OR COUNCILMEMBERS ON THEIR VARIOUS COMMITTEE MEMBERSHIPS AND MEETINGS ATTENDED AT PUBLIC EXPENSE.
12.1 VARIOUS COMMITTEE MEMBERSHIPS:
12.2 MEETINGS ATTENDED AT PUBLIC EXPENSE.
13. CITY COUNCIL REQUESTS FOR NEW AGENDA ITEMS.
14. CLOSED SESSION – PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
15. PRESENTATION BY CITY ATTORNEY of the following item(s) to be discussed in Closed Session:
15.1 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel and to receive direction from the City Council regarding the possible initiation of litigation by the City.
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL--ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
Initiation of litigation pursuant to paragraph (4) of subdivision
(d) of Section 54956.9: Number of cases – One.
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is in the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public or to disclose further the circumstances in this potential case; such disclosure may harm settlement attempts or other efforts to resolve the matter without litigation.
16. CLOSED SESSION.
17. ANNOUNCEMENT BY CITY ATTORNEY of item(s) discussed in Closed Session.
18. ADJOURNMENT.
